005package com.stuypulse.robot.opmodes;
006
007import com.stuypulse.robot.Robot;
008
009import org.wpilib.opmode.OpMode;
010import org.wpilib.opmode.Utility;
011
012@Utility(name = "Default Utility", description = "Does nothing")
013public final class DefaultUtility implements OpMode {
014    private final Robot robot;
015
016    public DefaultUtility(Robot robot) {
017        this.robot = robot;
018    }
019
020    @Override
021    public void start() {
022        robot.defaultScheduler.cancelAll();
023    }
024}
